notes: This portable C++ TCK slice actively subscribes one joined target to an adapter-selected object-class attribute declared as standard HLAbyte, registers two subject-owned instances, and delivers two updates for the first instance and one for the second. A distinct joined requester sends HLArequestObjectInstancesReflected naming the target in the standard HLAfederate parameter and receives the target's MIM count report. It verifies the class-based count is two distinct target instances. The nested count records use standard HLAinteger32BE. The test uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, public object-class handle decoding, HLAbyte, HLAinteger32BE, HLAoctet, HLAfixedRecord, HLAvariableArray, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM, application names, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation come from the adapter. It uses no private headers, provider registries, or vendor-specific names.
